title: Run prompt
text: Lock and trim input before beginning asynchronous work.
explanation: A React ref prevents duplicate submits immediately; the server independently checks untrusted input.

title: POST /api/agent/stream
text: POST JSON to the public Functions origin or the development proxy.
explanation: The browser sends an Entra bearer token only when public identity settings are configured; the Claude key never enters this client.
code: const response = await authorizedFetch(apiUrl('/api/agent/stream'), { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ prompt }), signal });

title: Validate bounded JSON input
text: Validate media type and actual bytes before parsing.
explanation: The 32 KiB limit applies while reading, independent of Content-Length. Strict JSON parsing and trimmed 1–4000 characters precede provider calls.

title: Delegate HTTP trigger
text: A real .NET isolated HTTP trigger delegates transport work.
explanation: The endpoint receives HttpContext through ASP.NET Core integration; no standalone Node or Minimal API server replaces Functions.

title: Create streaming model request
text: Call the official Anthropic C# Messages SDK.
explanation: The typed parameters above this line specify one user prompt, max tokens, model, optional system instructions and no tools. There is no CLI subprocess.

title: Receive SDK stream chunks
text: The SDK manages the HTTPS exchange with Claude.
explanation: This excerpt is the application request boundary. Provider transport is inside the official library; the diagram does not invent a raw HTTP call in application source.

title: Project safe text delta
text: Allowlist text instead of forwarding raw SDK objects.
explanation: Streaming redaction retains possible key prefixes between chunks, preventing the configured key leaking when split across provider deltas.

title: Write UTF-8 SSE event
text: Serialize and flush each application event.
explanation: The server awaits writes, sends heartbeat comments and bounds execution with linked request, invocation and deadline cancellation.

title: Update React answer and timeline
text: Update incremental answer text separately from final result.
explanation: Visible history caps at 500 events while final result processing continues; tab navigation keeps the mounted lab state.

title: Aggregate result and usage
text: Collect final text, token usage, duration and stop reason.
explanation: num_turns=1 denotes one model request. Cost remains null; a max_tokens stop is an error state even when partial text exists.

title: Dispatch final result
explanation: ResultMessage is our public contract, not the name of an official C# SDK class. Unknown or malformed messages are rejected.
code:
if (event === 'message') { const message = messageFrom(data); if (message.type === 'ResultMessage') finalReceived = true; onMessage(message); }

title: Render safe highlighted Markdown
explanation: Markdown code fences use Highlight.js; DOMPurify then removes active markup. Unknown languages display escaped plain text.

title: Complete final result plus done
text: Require a final result before sending transport completion.
explanation: React also requires final plus done. The final is_error flag still determines model success.

title: Emit safe stream error
text: Send an error without done when the provider or deadline fails.
explanation: Public failures omit raw exceptions, credentials and prompts. Client or host cancellation aborts owned work and disposes the iterator.
code:
if (!context.RequestAborted.IsCancellationRequested && !invocationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
    await SendEvent("error", new { detail = deadline.IsCancellationRequested ? "The request timed out. Try a shorter prompt." : Contracts.Failure });

title: Show recoverable browser error
text: Display failure in the answer card and notification.
explanation: Users can correct server configuration and retry. Cancel aborts fetch and stops the client run; no automatic duplicate paid requests are made.

title: Reject missing key before inference
text: Reject missing configuration before entering the SDK.
explanation: Simple mode returns HTTP 503; stream mode sends error without done. Lessons and documentation remain available locally without credentials.
code:
if (!settings.Configured) { await SendEvent("error", new { detail = Contracts.MissingKey }); return; }
